apis: Q1 SEPARATE SPACE, SAME SCENE, FAR OFFSET: THE UNDERNEATH is HOLLOW_HOME [120,-10,120] (src/world/hollow/config.ts:28), room half-size 9 and height 4.6 (config.ts:30-31). It is built inside buildLevel at src/world/level.ts:426 via buildHollow (src/world/hollow/index.ts:416), which returns {root, lights, statics, anchors, update, dispose}. level.ts:427-431 merges those into the level lists. world.ts:211-216 then moves statics into collision, anchors and props into the registries, and lights into the light pool.

Q1 ENTRY (teleport, not a scene change): HollowDoor.update (index.ts:266) fires enter() when the player crosses the doorway. enter() (index.ts:182-193) calls p.teleport(ARRIVE, 0) at 191, then swaps ambience with app.audio.ambience('void') at 193. EXIT: finish() (index.ts:370) teleports back to the stored pose at 381 and swaps ambience via ambienceAt (index.ts:66-73). This is the one working precedent for a separate space and reuses the pit's world.

Q1 TELEPORT: LocalPlayer.teleport(pos, yaw) (src/player/types.ts:44; impl src/player/local.ts:342) is an instant jump with no fade. The fade-in is only restored if fallOut set fadedOut (local.ts:172, 351). The cutscene jump-under-black pattern is app.ui.fade(1,0) then seek (src/core/cutscene/player.ts:401). Use an explicit fade around the teleport.

Q1 MAHJONG: no separate space. src/machines/mahjong is a machine module, and 'MAHJONG' is only a line-up pool tag (src/game/data/rooms.ts:85). 'Special rooms' are the seven wings, which are pit zones gated by grilles (src/game/data/rooms.ts:11, src/world/layout.ts:265-281), not separate spaces.

risks: TIMING (highest): the Dawn collection timer is 12 s (run.ts:234) and expires automatically (run.ts:1442-1444 calls dawn()). dawn() calls fall() when the quota is unpaid (run.ts:1963). The clock hold API (src/game/clockHold.ts) and the Watch clock tick (run.ts:1428-1433) do not cover collection. An elevator trip plus apartment cannot fit in 12 s, and an unhold would trigger the quota settlement early. A new hold on the Dawn phaseLeft is needed.

QUOTA-FAIL PATH: today a missed quota is fall() to endRun('fell') (run.ts:2017-2022), with a trapdoor cutscene (cutscenes/quota_fail.cutscene.ts:10). The mafia death must be a new endRun result and cutscene. Reusing the trapdoor anchor would look wrong.

NO FADE ON TELEPORT: LocalPlayer.teleport (local.ts:342-355) jumps instantly. The fade-in only restores if fadedOut was set by fallOut (local.ts:172, 351). The trip needs explicit app.ui.fade(1,dur,'#101019') then teleport then fade(0,...).

NO PHYSICAL LIFT: CollisionWorld has no moving-collider API (types.ts:36-44). carriedBy (local.ts:112, 181) follows a teammate, not a floor. The lift car (props/elevator.ts:158-163) is visual only and nothing calls ride(). A physical ride needs new per-frame collider or carry logic.

FALL LIMIT: below y = -12 the player is lost (player/controller.ts:35). The apartment floor must stay above it. The Hollow sits at y=-10 for this reason (hollow/config.ts:21-25).

LIGHT BUDGET: the pool renders POOL_SIZE real PointLights and retargets around the camera (sys/lightPool.ts:1-12). Keep the apartment to a few zone-tagged lights so setLevel(zone) works and the pit is not starved.

CULLING AND FOG: zoned level children are hidden when far (world.ts:614-616). Unzoned children stay visible at any distance. Fog far is 40 m (renderer/fog.ts:12). The apartment must sit beyond pit sightlines (the Hollow uses 120 m).

TIME MODEL: Watches (play phase) run on the pit floor and Dawn is the apartment entry, so 'phone messages during Watches' implies the phone reaches the player in the pit. phone:ring is global (hotline.ts:523) and lights the pool (world.ts:170), not a home phone. Decide whether messages arrive on the pit floor or only at home, or the design conflicts with the Dawn-only entry (run.ts:1937).

SOUNDS: no knock, chain, lock or light-switch sound exists. Usable: click (sfx.ts:152), doorCreak (825), doorSlam (829), footstep variants (852-857), phoneRing (760). Knock and chain need new assets or a substitution.

PROPS: no bed, peephole, chain-lock, light switch or home phone in the world. The kit catalogue is hats and masks (kit/props.ts:229-250). The only phone geometry is the hotline booth (machines/hotline/model.ts:62). These are new builders, following the management-door and hollow-doorway patterns.
HOLLOW INTERACTION: Dawn spends an unentered Hollow door (run.ts:1818). If the apartment and Hollow both reveal on the same Dawn, their ordering matters.

NIGHT ADVANCE: the only next-Night transition is openFloor() (run.ts:1486, index at 1501), gated by nightCardGate (1492) and bound to the intermission button (panels.ts:242). Sleep must call this or a new path. The night-card modal can block it.
HORROR OVERLAP: HorrorDirector owns the walking Collector and patrol actors (game/horror/director.ts:175-183). Hallway footsteps or knocks at home will need an agreed owner with that director.
